meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会通过 OneCLI 网关直接发起 HTTPS 请求访问外部服务;网关在代理层自动注入已保存的凭据,Claude 不需要看到密钥,也不需要你用浏览器授权。若请求失败,它会给出连接链接,等你连好后再重试。
howto.when: 当用户要求读邮件、查日历、访问 GitHub 仓库等,或要求与任何外部服务/API 交互时触发。

say.text: 帮我读一下 Gmail 最新 5 封邮件
查一下我的 GitHub 仓库列表
看看 Stripe 最近 5 笔收款
say.note: Claude 通过网关请求 Stripe API。

howto.what_en: Claude calls external APIs via the OneCLI gateway, which injects stored credentials automatically; Claude never sees secrets or uses browser auth. On failure, it shows a connect link and retries after user connects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read emails, check calendars, access GitHub repos, etc., or interact with any external service/API.

say_en.text: Read my latest 5 emails from Gmail.
say_en.note: Claude calls the Gmail API; the gateway injects credentials.
Claude requests the GitHub API; the gateway injects credentials.
Claude requests the Stripe API via the gateway.
